prompt:
The newsletter section in sections/newsletter-signup-escaped.liquid has correct markup, but its {% schema %} JSON is out of sync with it. Change only the JSON inside the single top-level {% schema %} block. Do not modify the markup above it. The markup treats its settings differently: - heading, email_label, placeholder (an HTML attribute) and button_label are always passed through `escape`, so they must be plain-text settings. - subtext is output raw inside a
, so it must be a richtext setting. Its default must be wrapped in a single

element. The final schema must be exactly the following, with keys at each level in this order and no other keys anywhere. Top level: - "name": "Newsletter" - "tag": "section" - "class": "section-newsletter" - "max_blocks": 3 (a number) - "settings": an array of six settings, in this order: 1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Get 10% off & free shipping" 2. type "richtext", id "subtext", label "Text", default "

New arrivals, restocks & members-only offers.

" 3. type "text", id "email_label", label "Email field label", default "Email address" 4. type "text", id "placeholder", label "Email placeholder", default "you@example.com" 5. type "text", id "button_label", label "Button label", default "Sign up" 6. type "select", id "alignment", label "Alignment", options [{"value":"left","label":"Left"},{"value":"center","label":"Center"}] (in that order), default "center" - "blocks": one block definition with type "note", name "Note", and settings containing exactly one setting: type "text", id "text", label "Text", default "We'll never share your email." - "presets": one preset with name "Newsletter" and blocks [{"type":"note"}] Key order inside each setting: type, id, label, then options (select only), then default. Inside the block definition: type, name, settings. Inside the preset: name, blocks. Defaults containing & must contain a literal & character, not &. Change only sections/newsletter-signup-escaped.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
